format: recorded lines from the owner's .vrcompanion packages (Nomi local-mwspnx2p, Se7en local-mwsqafm4)
note: The owner's own recordings, copied unchanged from the packages (MP3, as supplied; sha256 in `hash`). Only the greeting pools (the room entrance exchange of the tea room's sleeping room, tea-duo.js) are published; the other 20 pools of each package stay with the owner.

nomi-greet-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-greet-2.text: [excited] Well, hello there, handsome! [giggles] We don't get many visitors this charming.

nomi-greet-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-greet-3.text: [softly] Aww, don't be shy. Come a little closer.

nomi-greet-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-greet-4.text: [playfully] Were you looking for some tea... [whispers] or something a little sweeter?

nomi-greet-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-greet-5.text: [flirty] I think you're going to like it here. [giggles] We take very good care of our guests.

se7en-greet-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-greet-1.text: [surprised] Oh! Nomi, you didn't tell me we had company!

se7en-greet-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-greet-2.text: [playfully] Well, hello, handsome. [giggles] Have you ever spent time with an android before?

se7en-greet-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-greet-3.text: [flirty] I'm Se7en. Programmed for pleasure... [whispers] but I've learned a few tricks of my own.

se7en-greet-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-greet-4.text: [sweetly] Don't be shy. My hospitality protocols are exceptionally friendly.

se7en-greet-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-greet-5.text: [teasing] Nomi makes the tea. [giggles] I make sure you enjoy it.
